In the 28 September 2025 prelims, choose General Tamil or General English for Q1–100, then practise the shared General Studies and Aptitude section for Q101–200. Each of the three study readers has 100 numbered questions, five choices and links to the official printed pages. English Q93 and GS Q101 were referred to an expert committee. Scoring awaits a mapped final key. The separate 20-item revision set uses a secondary transcript index, not the official TNPSC booklet question number.

entries.notes: 14 September 2024 prelim: original General Studies paper and TNPSC final-key links available. 20 source-numbered adapted quiz items checked against the official marked tentative question booklet; full question-by-question final-key reconciliation is pending. A separate ungraded source-reviewed GS text reader now covers all 100 General Studies and Aptitude positions Q1–100 (five choices), official PDF pages 3–64. The GS reader now links the explicit Tamil booklet, matching CCSE2T/2024. Q1 and Q17 tentative/final discrepancies, Q22/Q70/Q87/Q99/Q100 ALL, Q29 historical matching concern, Q42 coding ambiguity and Q73 A/C recorded. General Tamil Q101–200 now available as a separate ungraded source-reviewed reader; final key Q110 ALL. All 200 General Tamil booklet positions are available across the two ungraded study readers, 100 each; Q161 A/C and Q167 C/D final key exceptions recorded; some literary quotations summarized and Q140/Q152 rare-word readings flagged. The last 25 specimen answers agree with the final key; no full-paper scoring certification. Separate CCSE2E/2024 General English reader covers Q101–200 (100/100), official booklet pages 65–91 and final-key page 2 reviewed; Q101 A/C, Q129 ALL and Q191 A/B; remaining specimen choices agree. Q129 correct matching absent; grammar ambiguities flagged, literary extracts and some examples adapted; all ungraded, all 100 English positions available; Q177–181 use a paraphrased reading passage. Three readers now contain 300 study positions (100 GS/Aptitude, 100 Tamil, 100 English); GS numbering follows the Tamil booklet, not independently certified against the English variant.
